decisions.reason: As a core drain-housing platform within the firm's drainage systems, it is likely to stay in the range if it has remained marketable several years after launch.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's strategic focus on accessible, low-profile bathroom solutions, so discontinuation is unlikely.
The designer shower drainage line was presented as a flagship direction of the firm and is therefore the least likely product to be withdrawn.
The shower element with integrated slope supports easier installation and renovation work, fitting the firm's practical system-selling approach.
Although more niche than the shower-focused lines, the backflow-protected basement floor drain addresses a clear technical need and strengthens the specialist portfolio.
The air-admittance valve is the most peripheral to the firm's visible design-led shower drainage focus, but it remains adjacent enough to keep as a complementary drainage product.
